experienceHighlights.text: Kept the possession plan and works schedule current with contractor progress for three renewal sites.
experienceHighlights.witness: Three years as project coordinator on a signalling renewals programme for a signalling contractor: the possession plan and the works schedule for three renewal sites were mine to keep current each week from the contractor's reported progress.

experienceHighlights.text: Recorded possession briefings and site access permits under programme procedures; records audited twice by the infrastructure owner with no findings.
experienceHighlights.witness: The possession briefings and the site access permits on the three sites were recorded by me under the programme's procedures; the infrastructure owner audited the records twice and raised no findings.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared and delivered weekly progress reports to the infrastructure owner's representative, including their comments.
experienceHighlights.witness: The infrastructure owner's representative received my weekly progress report on each site, and the reports with the representative's comments are in the programme folder.

experienceHighlights.text: Tracked equipment deliveries against the schedule, resolving delivery queries with suppliers and noting those requiring the project manager's possession decision.
experienceHighlights.witness: Equipment deliveries were tracked by me against the schedule in the delivery log, which marks the delivery queries I settled with the suppliers and the ones that needed the project manager's possession decision.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored hand‑over notes at each commissioning stage, countersigned by the commissioning engineer.
experienceHighlights.witness: Each commissioning stage on the three sites ended with my hand-over note, countersigned by the commissioning engineer.
